description: Changing IconSize from 48px to 96px at runtime immediately enlarges the icon cells, while the panel and item layout readjust smoothly.

assertions.comment: Immediately before the setting action, the default IconSize of 48px is used.
The runtime setting change takes effect in the next frame, with IconSize 96px.
The first item width also grows to 96px in the frame after the setting change.
The first item height also grows to 104px: the 96px icon plus 8px for the indicator dot.
The unnamed panel capture path width grows smoothly from the default 220px to the new content width of 412px.
The second item also moves smoothly from x=52 to x=100 to match the new first-item width.
The horizontal dock panel height immediately becomes 112px: IconSize 96px plus 16px of top and bottom padding.
